import { StrictMode } from 'react'
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom'
import { ConfigProvider } from 'antd'
import zhCN from 'antd/locale/zh_CN'
import './index.css'
import './App.css'
import './styles/table-global.css'
import { COLORS } from './styles/colors'
import App from './App.tsx'

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <BrowserRouter basename="/budget">
      <ConfigProvider
        locale={zhCN}
        theme={{
          token: {
            colorPrimary: '#00509e',
            borderRadius: 6,
            fontFamily: "-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif",
          },
        }}
      >
        <App />
      </ConfigProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  </StrictMode>,
)

import { api } from '../utils/api';
import type { SalesOpportunity, BlueTable } from '../types';

export const opportunityService = {
  list: (params?: Record<string, string>) =>
    api.get<SalesOpportunity[]>('/opportunities' + (params ? '?' + new URLSearchParams(params).toString() : '')),

  get: (id: string) =>
    api.get<SalesOpportunity>(`/opportunities/${id}`),

  getDetail: (id: string) =>
    api.get<SalesOpportunity & { blueTable: (BlueTable & { roles: any[] }) | null }>(`/opportunities/${id}/detail`),

  create: (data: Partial<SalesOpportunity>) =>
    api.post<SalesOpportunity>('/opportunities', data),

  update: (id: string, data: Partial<SalesOpportunity>) =>
    api.put<SalesOpportunity>(`/opportunities/${id}`, data),

  delete: (id: string) => api.delete(`/opportunities/${id}`),

  saveBlueTable: (id: string, data: { veto_budget?: string; budget_amount?: number; timeline_plan?: string; timeline_option?: string; pricing?: string; positioning?: number; reaction_mode?: string; strategy?: string; targets?: any[]; roles?: any[] }) =>
    api.put<BlueTable & { roles: any[] }>(`/opportunities/${id}/blue-table`, data),
};
